name: (E)-monocrotophos
summary: Monocrotophos is an organophosphate insecticide., India and many other countries.

uses.text: Monocrotophos is principally used in agriculture, as a relatively cheap pesticide. However, it is also used frequently as a tool to commit suicide. It is used as a pesticide for cucumber. Monocrotophos is believed to be the contaminant responsible for the death of 23 schoolchildren in a Bihar, India school.

summaryZh: 亞素靈（英語：Monocrotophos）是一種有機磷殺蟲劑，對人和鳥類也具有毒性。作為一種持久性有機污染物，已在美國等一些國家禁止使用。
summaryZhHans: 久效磷（英语：Monocrotophos）是一种有机磷杀虫剂，对人和鸟类也具有毒性。作为一种持久性有机污染物，已在美国等一些国家禁止使用。
